children: Grayscale Sui Staking ETF entered into an amendment to a Master Custody Service Agreement to add Anchorage Digital as an additional custodian for a portion of the Trust’s SUI holdings. Coinbase remains the primary custodian, while the Sponsor will determine allocations between custodians. Anchorage Digital will safeguard SUI and, on instruction, withdraw assets to pay the Sponsor's fee and permitted expenses. The move supports the Trust’s risk management approach as it grows.
: Custody services agreement for digital asset safekeeping
: Diversify custody and strengthen risk management for SUI holdings
